title: Docker
subtitle: Install Docker Engine, then manage containers, images, volumes, and validator Compose stacks on this host.
notInstalled: Docker Engine is not installed. Install docker.io and docker-compose-v2 from this page.
pruneConfirm: Type PRUNE to confirm any prune
stopEngineDesc: This stops the Docker engine and all {{n}} container(s) on this host.
runAdvancedHint: For multi-service stacks use validator nodes or Compose files already on this host.
daemonConfirmDesc: Writes daemon.json and restarts docker.service. All containers will be interrupted.
settingsHint: Safe daemon.json subset only. Apply writes the file and restarts docker.service.

cli.usage: Usage: ysk-server docker status|ps|images|volumes|networks|df|logs|inspect|exec|start|stop|restart|rm|pull|run|prune|engine|compose [--image IMG] [--name N] [--preset version|help|hostname] [--bin BIN] [--project P] [--execute] [--json]

empty.composeDesc: Projects come from validator nodes or Compose files already on this host. This page does not accept arbitrary YAML uploads.

deleteRunningWarn: This container is still running or restarting. It will be force-removed.

settings.liveRestore: Live restore (keep containers if the daemon restarts)

about.body: Docker is a first-class host service on YSK Server, like Nginx. Install via the panel (Ubuntu docker.io + docker-compose-v2). Validator nodes run as Compose projects named yskval-*.
about.honesty: Host changes need root and YSK_EXECUTE=1. Dry-run is the default. This page manages Docker on one host; use external Kubernetes for cluster orchestration.

alerts.daemonBody: The Docker engine is installed but docker.service is not active. Validator stacks cannot start.

errors.protectedNetwork: Cannot remove a built-in Docker network
errors.needPruneConfirm: Volume or system prune requires confirm=PRUNE
errors.composeMissing: Compose file for this project was not found
errors.badExec: Exec is limited to allowlisted binaries and presets (no shell, no TTY)
errors.uninstallBusy: Stop YSK-managed containers (including validator stacks) before uninstalling Docker

notes.dryMutate: Dry-run only. Pass --execute and YSK_EXECUTE=1 to change the host.

ui.whatYouGetLead: Install Docker Engine once. After that you can run a single container, pull images, and see validator Compose stacks that already live on this host.
ui.capEngineDesc: One-click install of docker.io and docker-compose-v2. Start and stop docker.service here.
ui.capWorkDesc: Pick a common image, pull it, run it, then read logs or inspect the container.
ui.capStacksDesc: Multi-service stacks are validator Compose projects (yskval-*). This page does not accept YAML uploads.
ui.imagePickHint: Choose a common image. Use Other only when you need a different reference.
ui.driverLocalOnly: This panel creates local volumes only.
ui.netDefaultDriver: New networks use Docker’s default bridge driver.
ui.pruneAck: I understand unused data will be deleted and cannot be restored
ui.pruneAckDesc: Volume and system prune cannot be undone. Stopped containers and unused images are removed for the selected scope.
ui.noVolumesYet: No volumes yet — create one on the Volumes tab first.

deleteC1: The resource is removed from this host.

pruneDesc: Type PRUNE to confirm. Unused data cannot be restored.
